content.what_it_is: A MATLAB preprocessing script that loads UTM-gridded DEM data and optional friction/obstacle layers from single-field MAT files, translates and rotates coordinates, interpolates them onto a local FUNWAVE grid, adds a constant-depth internal-wavemaker reach, a transition reach, and four sponge reaches, optionally blends north/south edges for a cyclic lateral boundary, plots intermediate/full products, reports grid indices and wavemaker position, and writes DEP.txt plus optional MANN.txt and OBS.txt row-wise (L1-L656). It solves the peak-wave finite-depth wavelength by fixed-point iteration (L204-L212), builds the full bathymetry by indexed block assignment (L242-L333), and reuses the same local/full grids for friction and binary obstacles (L416-L656).

unresolved: The script defines nx_extent_local=ceil(x_extent_local/dx_cells) and ny_extent_local analogously (L171-L172), but then creates exactly that many linspace samples from 0 through dx_cells*count (L175-L176). The actual adjacent spacing is dx_cells*count/(count-1), not dx_cells. The full-domain vectors repeat the same count/endpoint mismatch at L258-L259 while Mglob/Nglob are reported as nx_total/ny_total at L352-L355, so geometric coordinates, stated cell size, and array counts are not mutually consistent.

Each transition row uses linspace(depth_wavemaker,depths_edge_offshore(i),nx_interpolation) at L236-L238, including both endpoint values in nx_interpolation samples. The immediately adjacent measured-domain first column is depths_edge_offshore (L228, L269-L270), so the edge value is duplicated across the final transition sample and first measured sample while nx_interpolation was computed as a cell count at L224; this is another location/extent off-by-one.

interpolatedVectors is allocated with shape [nx_total,n_vectors_cyclic] at L317 and each column is one x-profile (L320-L322), but L326 and L330 assign an nx_total-by-1 column directly into a 1-by-nx_total row slice of zb_domain. MATLAB does not make these orientations conformable for matrix subscript assignment; the cyclic path needs an explicit transpose or a row-oriented temporary.

The finite-depth wavelength loop at L208-L212 has neither an iteration cap nor validation of Tp_wavemaker/depth_wavemaker. Nonconvergent finite inputs can loop indefinitely; NaN inputs make the comparison false and silently propagate NaN into later ceil-based extents.

DEM and friction are interpolated continuous-valued fields (L182, L460), but their text writers use integer conversion '%d' at L401 and L516. This is inconsistent with depths such as 30.85 (L58) and friction 0.02 (L90) and can quantize or otherwise integer-format values instead of preserving the required real precision; the obstacle writer's '%i' at L642 is consistent only because that layer is rounded at L583.

griddata may return NaN where the target grid lies outside the input convex hull (L182, L460, L577). The DEM NaNs are copied into the full domain and output (L269-L278, L401); friction NaNs overwrite the initialized outside value in the real-domain block (L477-L480); obstacle NaNs survive round and are inserted at L583 and L608. No isfinite/fill check exists before plots or text output.

The cyclic construction assumes ny_sponge_south+ny_sponge_north-1 is positive (L314) and then indexes interpolatedVectors using both sponge counts (L325-L330). Zero or very small configured sponge thicknesses can produce zero/negative allocation extents or invalid indices, despite the console instruction that cyclic FUNWAVE sponge thicknesses should be set to zero referring only to the later model input (L373-L377), not guarding preprocessing settings.
